renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (0x0000744C) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
notes: Chroma is max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B); reduced text chroma is not a complete sharpness score. Color-image chroma reduction can be an unwanted change, not an improvement.
Luma means gamma-encoded Rec.709 Y prime. RGB gamut clipping and byte rounding may change it after recombination.
CPU comparisons use the actual GPU-preprocessed source to isolate sampling behavior. This does not revalidate source defringe against its separate scalar implementation.
Text uses all six complete captured rows at three integer source offsets. Exported text shows three representative rows at zero offset, with shared crops.
Color tests include complete central tiles at zero motion; bounded 7 by 7 CPU sampling per tile. They are finite examples, not a proof against all false positives.
Original native captures are unmodified. Individual 50 and 66.667 percent variants are temporarily exposed in this test tab.
No timing, encoding, transport, HDR or actual product D3D test.
